description: This source file implements utility functions for interacting with a device's host interface via IPC, including initialization, error handling, parameter retrieval and setting, and command-line argument parsing.

methods.name: initilize
methods.description: Initializes the IPC bus connection, retrying until successful.

methods.name: getErrorDetails
methods.description: Returns a textual description of a fault code from the host interface.

methods.name: getParamType
methods.description: Retrieves the parameter type for a given parameter name via IPC call.

methods.name: convertParamValues
methods.description: Converts string input values to appropriate parameter types based on the parameter's type.

methods.name: convertType
methods.description: Converts a character code ('s', 'i', 'b') to a HostIf_ParamType_t enumeration.

methods.name: printParameterDetails
methods.description: Prints detailed information about a parameter based on its type.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: setAttribute
methods.description: Sets the value of a specified parameter.

methods.name: showusage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the command-line utility.

methods.name: parseargs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine operation mode and parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes, processes arguments, performs get/set operations, and cleans up.
